_readme: Copy to triage-rules.json and replace the EXAMPLE keywords with your own.
Every term below is a generic placeholder. Real client names, employer names,
family names and project code names belong in YOUR copy, which is gitignored.
Rules are evaluated top to bottom, first match wins, and the rule that fired is
written to metadata.triage.rule so you can audit and re-tier later.
Anything that matches nothing gets default_tier, which defaults to 'personal'.
Setting default_tier to 'standard' means anything your keywords miss is treated
as freely readable, so it requires "acknowledge_default_standard": true in this
same file. Regex escalation to restricted still applies either way.
A 'standard' verdict is re-checked against both regex sets before it is accepted,
so a badly ordered file cannot silently downgrade a recording containing an SSN.

rules.name: secrets
rules._comment: Credentials and identifiers. Always first: nothing should be able to outrank it.

rules.name: confidential-work
rules._comment: EXAMPLE TERMS — replace with your NDA clients, employers, and code names. mode 'summary' imports the Plaud summary only; the transcript is never sent to an LLM. Use mode 'skip' to import nothing, or 'full' to atomize normally.

rules.name: personal-life
rules._comment: EXAMPLE TERMS — replace with your own health, family, legal, and finance vocabulary.

rules.name: personal-signals
rules._comment: Health measurements, dosages, and money amounts anywhere in the scanned text.

rules.name: business-as-usual
rules._comment: EXAMPLE TERMS — replace with your own company, product, and teammate vocabulary. This is the ONLY rule that produces 'standard', and its verdict is still re-checked against both regex sets.
